environment.description: Same EC2 instance (m5.large) running identical Node.js 18 monolith, deployed in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no IGW route) within a dedicated VPC (10.200.0.0/16). Service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint policy restricts access to principals within a specific AWS Organization (o-abc123def4) and the endpoint's security group permits inbound TCP/3000 only from CIDR 10.200.1.0/24 (the consumer VPC's designated subnet). The consumer-side VPC endpoint has a private DNS entry resolving to the endpoint ENI. There is no public route table entry, no internet gateway, and no NAT gateway in the provider VPC. Additionally, the provider VPC has a Network ACL on the application subnet that denies all ingress from any source outside 10.200.0.0/16. The VPC flow logs show only traffic originating from the consumer endpoint ENIs. Note: the PrivateLink service has acceptance_required=true, meaning new endpoint connections must be manually approved.
